properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure organization's cloud system maintenance controls are compliant with the following standards: scheduling and documenting all maintenance, repair, and replacement activities; obtaining explicit approval for off-site maintenance; sanitizing equipment to remove sensitive information; verifying control functionality post-maintenance; maintaining detailed records including dates, personnel, and actions. (Infra-Security-103).

metadata.Description:
Ensure organization's cloud system maintenance controls are compliant with the following standards: scheduling and documenting all maintenance, repair, and replacement activities; obtaining explicit approval for off-site maintenance; sanitizing equipment to remove sensitive information; verifying control functionality post-maintenance; maintaining detailed records including dates, personnel, and actions; and conducting regular record reviews and audits.
Schedule, document, and review records of maintenance, repair, and replacement on system components. Approve and monitor all maintenance activities. Require explicit approval for off-site maintenance. Sanitize equipment to remove sensitive information before off-site maintenance. Verify controls are functioning properly after maintenance. Maintain detailed maintenance records including dates, personnel, and actions performed
